title: Markdown notes
summary: Markdown notes: Markdown files with front matter in data/global and data/sessions/<id>.
stored_as: Markdown files with front matter in data/global and data/sessions/<id>
how_it_is_searched: Keyword search with excerpts of about 25 lines, or a full note when a path is given
size_limits: Prompt context is cut to 12,000 characters in total

title: Embeddings
summary: Embeddings: JSON files under data/embeddings, built by a background queue.
stored_as: JSON files under data/embeddings, built by a background queue
how_it_is_searched: Cosine match on 768-dimension vectors from Google gemini-embedding-001
size_limits: Queue: 5 items per batch, up to 5 attempts
fallback: Keyword search with a note that vectors are off

title: Event log
summary: Event log: One JSONL file per UTC day, append only.
stored_as: One JSONL file per UTC day, append only
size_limits: Text 4,000 chars, day file about 1 MB, recall 50 default and 200 max
